thread:
nina_people_ops: Quick heads-up: mid-cycle review ops tweak proposal. Aim: reduce manager backlog spikes and get calibration signals earlier. Need greenlight by EOD.

clara_manager: Curious how this impacts managers with small teams (4-6 ppl). We don’t want overly fragmented batches.

nina_people_ops: Good call. For teams <=6 we'll keep single-batch deadlines (no split). Splits apply to teams >6.

rahul_eng_lead: Can you outline the timelines? also how do reviewers know which items are early-signal?

nina_people_ops: Timeline outline:
- Day 0: reviewers notified and CSV exported to manager queues.
- Day 2: automated reminder (ops-bot).
- Day 3: 60% batch due (for teams >6).
- Day 4: Signal Check session (two timezone-friendly runs).
- Day 7: remaining batch due.
- Day 8: Consensus & Escalation session.

Early-signal tagging rules: high-impact ICs (customer metrics), recent launches, or roles with cross-team dependencies. Managers can flag additional names in the sheet.

jin_recruiter: Note: several hires start next week; sending a CSV of start dates so ops can exclude them from early-signal sampling.

nina_people_ops: Thanks Jin. Also: we'll add a "manager opt-in" column for teams that want earlier full deadlines. Ops will run a QA script that picks 8 random reviews per manager for spot-checking before calibration.

clara_manager: Appreciate the small-team exemption. Also request: include a short checklist for reviewers (criteria to evaluate) in the reminder DM.

nina_people_ops: Will do. Draft checklist: "impact summary, objectives alignment, stretch areas, calibration note (score rationale)". We'll paste in the reminder message.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Day 2 (48h), Day 6 (48h left for slower queues), Final reminder Day 9. Calendar invites created for Signal Check and Consensus sessions.

rahul_eng_lead: LGTM from infra & platform.

nina_people_ops: Great  locking and publishing plan unless objections by EOD. If you want accelerated deadlines DM me to be marked in sheet. :white_check_mark:
